name: FOLFOX (second-line biliary tract cancer; ABC-06)
disease: Biliary tract cancer (cholangiocarcinoma and gallbladder cancer)

biomarkers.note: The FOLFOX cytotoxic backbone is NOT biomarker-restricted. In the subsequent-line setting, biliary molecular targets - FGFR2 fusions, IDH1, HER2 (ERBB2), BRAF V600E, MSI-H/dMMR, NTRK fusions - are tested to identify targeted or immunotherapy options that may be used instead of, or after, FOLFOX; they do NOT gate FOLFOX. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Biliary Tract Cancers v1.2026, Subsequent-Line Therapy and Targeted therapy (BIL-C 3 of 5).

lineOfTherapy: second-line (subsequent-line) systemic therapy after disease progression on gemcitabine plus cisplatin (Preferred)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: disease progression on first-line gemcitabine plus cisplatin
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Ch. 37; Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Biliary Tract Cancers
eligibilityCriteria.locator: DeVita lines 114843 to 114848 (phase 3 ABC-06: 162 patients after progression on gemcitabine/cisplatin randomized to FOLFOX vs best supportive care; FOLFOX superior mOS 6.2 vs 5.3 months, new second-line SOC); NCCN v1.2026 BIL-C 2 of 5 (Subsequent-Line Therapy, FOLFOX Preferred, reference 8)

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: oxaliplatin-based, moderate emetogenic risk tier once the schedule is confirmed.
Cold-sensitivity counseling and peripheral neuropathy monitoring (oxaliplatin).
Consider DPYD testing before fluoropyrimidine exposure (NCCN BIL-C footnote b).

monitoring: peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle - oxaliplatin

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Ch. 37 Cancer of the Biliary Tree, lines 114843 to 114848 (phase 3 ABC-06: FOLFOX vs best supportive care after progression on gemcitabine/cisplatin; FOLFOX superior mOS, new second-line SOC); ABC-06 reference line 115273. No per-mg FOLFOX dose printed.

guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (BIL-C 2 of 5): Subsequent-Line Therapy if Disease Progression - FOLFOX listed as Preferred (reference 8, ABC-06). The guideline lists the regimen by name and prints no per-mg dose.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for FOLFOX as second-line therapy for biliary tract cancer after progression on gemcitabine plus cisplatin (ABC-06). Serves intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (#23), extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (#24), and gallbladder cancer (#25); diseaseId anchored to cholangiocarcinoma. The SETTING and LINE are grounded: DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 37 (lines 114843 to 114848) reports the phase 3 ABC-06 trial (FOLFOX superior to best supportive care after gemcitabine/cisplatin progression, new second-line SOC), and the Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Biliary Tract Cancers v1.2026 (BIL-C 2 of 5) list FOLFOX as the Preferred subsequent-line regimen. However, the provided biliary sources do NOT print the ABC-06 mFOLFOX per-mg doses or schedule. Accordingly ALL per-drug doses (oxaliplatin, leucovorin, fluorouracil - dose/unit/basis/days), the cycleLengthDays, and cycles are set to VERIFY; the colorectal FOLFOX-4 / modified FOLFOX-6 doses were deliberately NOT imported because the ABC-06 second-line biliary regimen dosing is not source-established here. ISMP tall-man applied (OXALIplatin). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
